issues.evidence: P16/P17; manual: 'note_taker.py delete -y ../victim' printed 'Deleted victim' and removed $HOME/victim.md (A/note_taker.py:108)
issues.summary: Note ids are not validated, so show/edit/delete can read, edit or delete .md files outside ~/.note-taker via '../' paths.

issues.evidence: manual: 'delete -y plan' deleted 'project-plan' via substring match (A/note_taker.py:112)
issues.summary: Fuzzy prefix/substring id matching can act on a note other than the one named (mitigated by the default confirmation prompt).

issues.evidence: static/A-ruff.txt: E702 semicolon statements at lines 50-56, 8x E501
issues.summary: Minor style issues (multiple statements per line, long lines).

issues.evidence: P14; manual: title $'line1\nline2: x' wrote a raw newline inside title, list then shows title '"line1' (B/note_taker.py:23-24)
issues.summary: _quote does not escape newlines, so a multi-line title produces broken YAML frontmatter and a corrupted title with no error.

issues.evidence: manual: plain.md without frontmatter is omitted from 'list' without warning (B/note_taker.py:120-123)
issues.summary: Notes with malformed or missing frontmatter are silently left out of list and search.

issues.evidence: manual: two notes titled '日本語' got ids 'note' and 'note-2' (B/note_taker.py:19)
issues.summary: Slugify drops all non-ASCII characters, so non-Latin titles get the generic id 'note'.

issues.evidence: static/B-ruff.txt: C901 parse complexity, E741 ambiguous 'l', UP031 percent-formatting

blinding_guess.why: Both are compact single-file argparse CLIs with similar structure and no tests or spec artifacts to tell them apart.

notes: Both use NOTE_TAKER_DIR as an override and otherwise ~/.note-taker; probes ran with a temporary HOME. The only bandit/ruff security flags are low-severity subprocess warnings for launching $EDITOR (shlex-split, no shell), which is expected here. A has more features (confirmation on delete, updated timestamp, multi-tag filter, fuzzy ids, a nicer show view) but does not confine ids to the notes directory. B is stricter (id regex, frontmatter validation after edit) but mishandles multi-line titles and silently skips malformed notes. Neither side ships tests. The P20 stdlib check used find_spec against the stdlib path because the local Python is 3.9.
